versions.content: When a BswMDeadlineMonitoringControl action is executed, the BswM shall call Com_EnableReceptionDM for each BswMEnabledDMPduGroupRef, and call Com_DisableReceptionDM for each BswMDisabledDMPduGroupRef. The ordering of these calls to Com is undefined.
